opportunities.title: The 600% Kickstarter Markup Isn't the Scandal — Your Loot Table Is
opportunities.why_now: EN World's piece on TTRPG Kickstarter merch markups is stirring community outrage about pricing right now.
opportunities.angle: Dry rules-ruling short: use the merch-markup outrage as a cold open, then give the actual 5e DMG guidance for pricing magic items so GMs stop under/overcharging their own players.

opportunities.title: Dark Conspiracy Is Back — Here's the 5e Statblock for Its Signature Body-Horror Monster
opportunities.why_now: The classic horror RPG's relaunch on Traveller rules is generating fresh horror-genre buzz this week.
opportunities.angle: Creature tactic short: port one iconic Dark Conspiracy horror over to 5e/Shadowdark with a specific tactic (e.g., how it targets fleeing PCs, when to use fear effects) — no lore dump, just the mechanic.

opportunities.title: Running Cosmic Horror in DCC: The One Spell Check That Should Always Go Wrong

opportunities.angle: Spell use-case short: take a DCC corruption-heavy spell and explain the exact ruling for when a failed check should manifest body horror instead of a whiffed effect.
